story.iWant: to see a line chart visualizing how my total debt decreases over time for each strategy
story.soThat: I can visually compare strategy trajectories and understand the path to becoming debt-free

tasks.task: Create DebtReductionChart component structure with Recharts LineChart and ResponsiveContainer
Transform strategy monthlyProjections data for chart consumption with memoization
Configure chart axes: X-axis (months), Y-axis (total debt ZAR)
Define color palette and line styles (baseline dashed gray, recommended solid teal)
Implement interactive Recharts tooltip with formatCurrency
Implement legend with toggle functionality for strategy visibility
Optimize performance for large datasets (sample every 3rd point for >120 months)
Implement responsive mobile layout with simplified view
Implement empty state for no calculated strategies
Write unit tests covering all acceptance criteria
Verify build and all tests pass

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given strategies have been calculated, when I view the Compare page, then I see a Recharts line chart with X-axis = months (0 to debt-free) and Y-axis = total debt (ZAR)
Each strategy is represented by a distinct line with a unique color from the defined color palette
The baseline strategy line is rendered as a dashed gray line (strokeDasharray) to visually distinguish it from optimized strategies
The recommended strategy (highest interestSaved) is rendered as a solid teal line (teal-600) for visual emphasis
Hovering over any data point shows a Recharts tooltip displaying: month number, strategy name, and exact debt value (ZAR formatted)
A clickable legend allows users to toggle individual strategy lines on/off to reduce visual clutter
Chart renders in under 2 seconds for projections up to 360 months (NFR-P3 performance requirement)
On mobile (<640px), the chart simplifies: reduced legend visibility, larger touch targets, sampled data points
Component shows skeleton loading state while isCalculating is true from calculation store
If no strategies are calculated (empty results), show an appropriate empty state message

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR26: System generates visual comparison charts showing debt reduction curves over time for all strategies. FR43: System generates interactive debt reduction curve charts showing balance over time.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Charts component folder at src/components/charts/. Uses Recharts (^3.5.1) for React-native charts. DebtReductionChart.tsx handles debt reduction curves with line chart visualization.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Visual hierarchy: Debt reduction curves (all strategies overlaid on one chart). Interactive Charts: Line charts for trends. 2025 best practices: Charts should be interactive with hover tooltips.

doc.title: Epic 5 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: AC-5.3.1 through AC-5.3.7 defined. Performance risk: Chart with 360 months may be slow - mitigation: sample every 3rd data point for long projections.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Implement Debt Reduction Curve Chart. Use Recharts LineChart component. Colors from UX spec: teal for recommended, varied for others. Limit data points if > 360 months (sample every 3rd month).

constraints.constraint: Use Recharts (not Chart.js) for all charting - already installed and documented
All monetary values use big.js for precision - convert Big to number for chart
Client-side only - no external API calls
Balanced Teal theme: teal-600 (#0d9488) for recommended/primary
WCAG AA accessibility - keyboard navigation, screen reader support
Chart renders in under 2 seconds (NFR-P3) - sample data for long projections
Color-blind accessibility: use distinct line styles (solid, dashed, dotted) not just colors
Exports via src/components/charts/index.ts (create if not exists)

tests.standards: Testing framework: Vitest with React Testing Library Pattern: Organize tests by acceptance criteria (describe blocks per AC) Mock data: Use createMockStrategy factory function to generate test data with monthlyProjections Assertions: Use @testing-library/jest-dom matchers (toBeInTheDocument, toHaveClass, etc.) Coverage: Each AC should have at least one dedicated test Recharts testing: Use screen queries for rendered SVG elements, check for data-testid attributes
